entries.zh_cn: 看哪，那些兽被解放了出来
entries.ja: 見よ、獣は解き放たれた
entries.english: And lo, vile beasts did rise,

entries.zh_cn: 它们杀害世人、烧毁城镇
entries.ja: それらは人々を殺し、街を焼いた
entries.english: Leaving naught in their wake but blood and ash.

entries.ja: これが、第一の災いである
entries.english: Thus did the first doom befall us.

entries.zh_cn: 随后，仍有两场灾难将到来
entries.ja: この後、なお二つの災いが来る
entries.english: It would not, however, prove the last.

entries.zh_cn: 我们的明天已化为余烬
entries.ja: 明日は燃え殻となり塵となった
entries.english: For soon did the sun bend low, scorching earth and boiling seas.

entries.ja: これが、第二の災いである
entries.english: Thus did the second doom break us.

entries.zh_cn: 毁灭犹如暗影迅速扩张
entries.ja: 滅びは影のように速い
entries.english: Yet it was neither claw nor flame, but our very sins─

entries.ja: すべてが失われようとしていた
entries.english: Stacked to the heavens where they took root, corrupting its halls─

entries.ja: これが、第三の災いである
entries.english: Thus did the third doom undo us.
